description: Every Blumira finding, detection, and agent across your direct org and every MSP sub-account — in one offline-searchable store with cross-account triage and over-time trends no single API call can answer.

auth_env_var_specs.name: BLUMIRA_API_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Blumira JWT bearer token. Minted+cached by `auth login`, or set directly. Set this OR BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID + BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET.

auth_env_var_specs.name: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: Blumira API Client ID (Settings > Organization > Generate API Credentials). Used with BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET by `auth login` to mint a JWT.

auth_env_var_specs.name: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: Blumira API Client Secret. Used with BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID by `auth login` to mint a JWT (client_credentials, audience=public-api).

novel_features.name: Unified cross-account triage queue
novel_features.description: One globally-ranked open-findings queue across every MSP client account.

novel_features.name: Finding drift since last sync
novel_features.description: New, status-changed, and newly-resolved findings since the last sync, per account.

novel_features.name: MTTR & response velocity
novel_features.description: Mean-time-to-resolve and open-rate per account or overall.

novel_features.name: SLA aging watchlist
novel_features.description: Findings about to breach an age-based SLA across all accounts, ranked.

novel_features.name: Detection coverage drift vs basis
novel_features.description: Detection rules missing or disabled in your org versus the MSP basis ruleset.

novel_features.name: Agent & domain-controller exposure map
novel_features.description: Cross-account agent rollup that flags stale or unprotected domain controllers.

novel_features.name: Resolution re-fire audit
novel_features.description: Findings that were resolved and then re-fired (reopened).

novel_features.name: Recurring-finding fingerprint
novel_features.description: The same detection firing repeatedly across accounts and time.

novel_features.name: Self-minting OAuth2 auth login
novel_features.description: Mints, caches, and auto-refreshes the Blumira JWT from a Client ID + Secret.

novel_features.name: Cross-account MSP overview
novel_features.description: One-screen per-account rollup: open findings by priority, agent coverage, and detection-coverage drift across every client.

novel_features.name: Ticketing reconciliation export
novel_features.description: Flat finding-to-org-to-assignee-to-status table for diffing against ConnectWise, Jira, or Zendesk.

novel_features.name: Evidence keyword search
novel_features.description: Full-text search over synced finding evidence to find which findings mention an IOC, hostname, or user.

novel_features.name: Domain-controller roster
novel_features.description: Every domain controller across all accounts with last check-in and protected/stale state.

novel_features.name: Per-analyst workload balance
novel_features.description: Open assigned findings grouped by owner across all accounts, with age buckets.
